### Added

- (agent-platform) [Keep a compact session header at the top while reading](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3015) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Scrolling down a long session turns its header into a compact bar at the top of the page with the name, state, agent, `Show tool activity`, pin and actions menu; scrolling back up restores it. At phone width the bar leaves out `Show tool activity`.

### Changed

- (agent-platform, muster) [Build shell links through route refs](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3021) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — No visible change: links into the Agent Platform are built from its route definitions instead of written-out addresses, in preparation for moving its pages to new addresses.
- (app, muster) [Map old Agent Platform addresses to the new URL tree](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3029) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — An old link to a connector's Settings tab now opens the connector's Tools tab. The rest prepares redirects for the Agent Platform's move to new addresses and changes nothing yet.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Measure context from the newest model call and correct Claude windows](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3019) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In a session's cost popover, `Context used` shows what the model was last sent, no longer a sum over the turn's calls (`969.0k of 200.0k · 100%`), against a 1M window for current Claude models such as Opus 5.5. Above the configured window it says so; Claude Code Harness sessions show `Not reported`.
- (muster) [Read mcpservers and workflows in muster's namespace when a cluster-wide list is refused](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3036) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For a person with only namespaced Agent Platform access, the Customize pages no longer show `Errors when trying to fetch resources from …`, and list the MCP servers the person may read in muster's namespace.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3037) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Updates the generated CircleCI workflow, auto-release workflow and Makefile from the shared templates in giantswarm/github.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.6.0...v3.7.0
